issues.where: Right-side night limb, including the small green glows east and southeast of South America (pair-02-b.png crops E, H and I)
issues.what: The localized auroral accents are much fainter, especially the compact lower green streak and the patch just inside the mid-right limb. The surrounding blue edge also reads a little broader.
issues.fix: Restore the two localized green peaks and their short filament texture without lifting the surrounding night-side blacks; keep the blue edge confined to the limb.

issues.where: Upper-right green curtain, red fringe and immediately adjacent sky (pair-02-b.png crop C)
issues.what: The curtain has softer, less distinct vertical rays and a more diffuse green spill, with less separation between the narrow green strands and red fringe.
issues.fix: Recover the thin vertical green rays and their local contrast, confine the spill, and retain the soft red falloff behind them.

issues.where: Daylit Americas, Pacific cloud bands and night-side South American lights (crops A, F, G and H)
issues.what: The fine Gulf and Caribbean shoreline, Andes texture, cloud filaments and individual city lights resolve less crisply; a few bright points merge into softer clusters.
issues.fix: Restore the native fine texture and point separation selectively while leaving the established daylight and night-side grade in place.

issues.where: Moon, star field and sunlit cyan limb (pair-02-b.png crops B, D, F and G)
issues.what: The Moon's surface markings and small stars are slightly softer; the blue limb has a less distinct bright core against its wider halo.
issues.fix: Recover subtle lunar crater contrast and tight stellar points, and separate the thin cyan-white limb core from its outer falloff.

issues.where: Atmospheric ribbon across the upper horizon (pair-04-b.png crops B and C)
issues.what: The blue-to-white transition is slightly more diffuse, reducing definition along the bright inner horizon and the nearest horizontal cloud layers.
issues.fix: Bring back the narrow bright transition and the delicate cloud layering without hardening the outer atmospheric fade.

issues.where: Central sun track, foreground cloud rims and shadow edges, and the right-hand shallow banks and island coast (crops A and D through I)
issues.what: The sunlit water's ripple and glint texture is less crisp, foreground clouds and shadows lose a little edge definition, and the coastline and shoal markings are slightly softened.
issues.fix: Recover fine-scale contrast in the water, cloud rims and coastal detail without changing the sun track, shadow direction or blue and turquoise grade.
